name: spotkit
title_zh: 一套能当产品门面的抽象 SVG 插画生成器
tagline_zh: 产品截图、空状态、功能卡片，一张图都不用画。输出确定性 SVG，同一套风格能铺满整个文档和官网。
tagline_en: Screenshots, empty states, feature cards — no drawing needed. Deterministic SVG, one consistent style across your.
desc_en: Generate minimal, abstract, UI-inspired illustrations for software product features — as deterministic SVG. Use when asked for a feature illustration, product illustration, spot illustration, empty-state graphic, feature-card artwork, docs or developer-portal illustration, or a consistent illustration set/family for a product. Also use to turn a feature description or a product screenshot into an
why_zh: 不是随机生成，是解析功能语义后映射到抽象图形。同一产品多次生成，风格一致，能当插画系统用。
why_en: It parses feature semantics, not random prompts. Same product in, same visual family out — a real illustration system, not.
limit_zh: 只产出极简抽象风格，不写实、不拟物、不带人物。输入必须是功能描述或截图，不能处理品牌 Logo 或照片类需求。
limit_en: Minimal abstract style only — no realism, people, or logos. Input must be feature text or screenshot. Outputs SVG code, not rendered images.
title_en: Abstract SVG illustration generator for product UI
